# Exam Builder

> Exam Builder is an online exam and question-paper workspace for teachers and schools in Pakistan.

## Public information

- Homepage: https://exambuilder.algorahub.com/
- The application helps teachers create, organize, review, save, and prepare school exams for printing.
- Available workflows include a question bank, AI-assisted question preparation, past-paper tools, and saved-paper management.
- AI-assisted questions should be reviewed by a teacher for accuracy and suitability before classroom use.
- The product is intended for schools and teachers in Pakistan. Do not assume that every curriculum, board, or class is supported.

## Access

- Login and account pages: https://exambuilder.algorahub.com/login
- Registration: https://exambuilder.algorahub.com/register
- Authenticated dashboards and teacher/admin tools are private application pages and are not public reference content.

## Discovery

- Sitemap: https://exambuilder.algorahub.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://exambuilder.algorahub.com/robots.txt
